proposed_fixes.title: PowerToys tray context menus do not follow the configured dark theme
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The tray context menu uses a native Win32 menu path that may not inherit the Settings app theme preference or OS dark-mode menu attributes.
plan: Trace how the runner creates tray and module context menus and which OS/theme preference is applied.
Apply supported dark-mode menu attributes consistently while retaining high-contrast behavior.
Add a UI test for main and module tray menus in dark and high-contrast modes.
verification: With Windows/PowerToys dark theme enabled, right-click the main and module tray icons and verify both menus use the expected theme.

comment.body: Thanks for showing that both the main and module tray menus remained white while PowerToys was in dark mode. Could you confirm the current PowerToys/Windows versions and whether Windows app mode is also set to Dark (not only PowerToys Settings)? This distinguishes a native OS menu setting from a PowerToys-specific theme mismatch.
